description_en: Remove the client from the blacklist
description_zh: 从CPFS服务中，将客户端移出黑名单，恢复其写入请求
kebab_example: aliyun nas remove-client-from-black-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --file-system-id cpfs-00d91ca404a3480000 --client-ip 192.168.0.0 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveClientFromBlackList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the file system resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file system
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of a client to remove from the blacklist
parameters.help_zh: 待移出黑名单的客户端IP地址
parameters.name: client_ip

parameters.help_en:
This parameter ensures the idempotency of each request. A ClientToken is generated for each client. Make sure that each ClientToken is unique between different requests. The parameter can be a maximum of 64 characters in length and contain only ASCII characters.

For more information, see How to ensure idempotence (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/25693.htm)
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。

更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
